items.description: Online DNS lookup: remote DNS lookup (nslookup/dig) a host or domain from 30+ locations worldwide.
Perform a traceroute from 3 stations in the WatchMouse monitoring network.
Utility to perform a ICMP Ping from 30+ location worldwide.
Down or Not checks a website from 3 locations in the WatchMouse network and decides if a site is indeed down or not.

The WatchMouse service checks the behavior and availability of websites. WatchMouse allows site owners to optimize the internet experience of their customers.A worldwide network checks websites from 40 different locations in 25 countries around the globe.The API provides access to data collected via the service, access to monitoring settings, and direct commands to check a site.
